resources.string: Keep my key on this device only
When backup is on, your phone's backup keeps an encrypted copy of your journal key. Without it, a lost phone needs your recovery phrase or LogDate account.
Your journal key stays out of your phone's backup. A lost phone needs your recovery phrase or LogDate account. Moving directly to a new phone still works.
Google Play services didn't confirm this change, so your key's backup copy may not match it yet. Switch it again to retry.
